turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must say, Your Majesty, I am intrigued by the circumstances surrounding your visit. May I inquire as to the nature of the matter that brings you to our humble abode today?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I must confess, Doctor Watson, I am at a loss for how to proceed. The weight of my situation is crushing me, and I fear for the future of my kingdom.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I must say, Count Von Kramm, that your distress is palpable, but I must insist on hearing the particulars of your situation. Pray tell, what is the nature of this weight that bears down upon you?

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I couldn't help but notice, Your Majesty, that you seem to be under some considerable strain. Might I suggest that a glass of water and a chair would be a great comfort to you in this trying moment?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: Ah, good sir, Dr. Watson, your kindness is most appreciated, but I fear I must compose myself for the task at hand. The weight of my confession bears down upon me, and I must be cautious in revealing the secrets that I entrust to you.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Pray, sir, be at ease, and tell us what brings you to us today. Your distress is palpable, and I'm sure Sherlock Holmes and I will do everything in our power to assist you.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I must confess, gentlemen, that I am indeed troubled, and my presence here is a matter of utmost gravity, one that requires the utmost discretion and care. I fear for the safety and well-being of those dear to me, and I have come to you, Sherlock Holmes, in the hope that your singular abilities and expertise may be able to unravel the tangled threads of a most delicate situation.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: May I ask, Your Highness, what specific nature of trouble besets you, and how do you believe Mr. Holmes' expertise may be of assistance in unraveling this delicate situation?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: Forgive me, gentlemen, but I fear I may be placing too great a burden upon your discretion, and yet I see no alternative. I implore you, Mr. Holmes, to understand that the matters which concern me are of the utmost gravity and delicacy, and that the consequences of failure could be... catastrophic.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must say, Your Majesty, that your words have certainly piqued our interest. Might I inquire what specific matters you believe require our... particular set of skills?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I must confess, gentlemen, that I am at a loss for how to proceed. My situation is... precarious, and I fear that if I do not act swiftly, the consequences may be... catastrophic.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I presume, Your Majesty, that you have not come to me for the sake of idle gossip, but rather to benefit from my singular abilities in unraveling the tangled threads of this... precarious situation. Pray tell, what are the specifics of your concern?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I must confess, Mr. Holmes, that my situation is... dire. My, ah, loved one, Irene Adler, has been compromised, and I fear for her safety, as well as the stability of my, shall we say, delicate position in Europe.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: A compromising position, you say? I must know more about this Irene Adler and the nature of your... delicate position in Europe.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I fear, Mr. Holmes, that the matter is far more complex than you can imagine. My position, as you see, is not merely a personal one, but one that has far-reaching implications for the stability of the continent.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I must insist, Count Von Kramm, that you tell me everything. The more I understand, the better equipped I am to assist you.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I must confess, gentlemen, that the matter is of the utmost gravity, and I fear for the future of Europe if it is not resolved with all due haste.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must admit, Your Highness, that your concern is palpable. May I ask, what specific circumstances have led you to believe that this matter requires our immediate attention?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: Gentlemen, I am afraid I am not at liberty to disclose the full extent of the situation. Suffice it to say that the implications are far-reaching and potentially catastrophic, and I fear that I am running out of time to prevent a great calamity.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I see, Your Highness. You're not at liberty to disclose, but I suspect you're not here to discuss the weather either. Pray tell, what information you are willing to share, and let us proceed accordingly.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: I told you that I would call.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: Pray take a seat. This is my friend and colleague, Dr. Watson, who is occasionally good enough to help me in my cases. Whom have I the honour to address?

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You may address me as the Count Von Kramm, a Bohemian nobleman. I understand that this gentleman, your friend, is a man of honour and discretion, whom I may trust with a matter of the most extreme importance. If not, I should much prefer to communicate with you alone.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: It is both, or none. You may say before this gentleman anything which you may say to me.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: Then I must begin, by binding you both to absolute secrecy for two years; at the end of that time the matter will be of no importance. At present it is not too much to say that it is of such weight it may have an influence upon European history.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You will excuse this mask. The august person who employs me wishes his agent to be unknown to you, and I may confess at once that the title by which I have just called myself is not exactly my own.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: The circumstances are of great delicacy, and every precaution has to be taken to quench what might grow to be an immense scandal and seriously compromise one of the reigning families of Europe. To speak plainly, the matter implicates the great House of Ormstein, hereditary kings of Bohemia.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: I was also aware of that

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: Our visitor glanced with some apparent surprise at the languid, lounging figure of the man who had been no doubt depicted to him as the most incisive reasoner and most energetic agent in Europe. Holmes slowly reopened his eyes and looked impatiently at his gigantic client.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: If your Majesty would condescend to state your case, I should be better able to advise you.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You are right. I am the King. Why should I attempt to conceal it?
